en-US.title: Paper Shot: Memory Game
en-US.shortDescription: Remember the numbers, then tap the targets in order. Beat your best!
en-US.fullDescription:
Paper Shot is a quick memory challenge on a sheet of paper.

Watch the numbered targets, remember their order, then tap them from 1 upward after the numbers disappear. Each round adds more targets, while wrong-order shots cost time.

• A practice round teaches you how to play
• Increasing challenges with up to six targets
• Personal best score and round saved on your device
• Adjustable music, sound, screen shake and reduced motion
• No sign-in, ads or in-app purchases

Music: Sneaky Snitch by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

releaseNotes.en-US: Initial release: numbered-target memory challenges, local personal bests, music and accessibility settings.
